-- EP-488 v50 / G2: Degree-3 rigidity (patched U2')
-- Claim: If deg_B(a) = 3 under top-window and n ∈ [2q, 3q), then
--   - 5a ≤ n, so a < 3q/5
--   - S_{3a} = {a, 3a/2}, forcing 2 | a
--   - S_{4a} = {a, 4a/3}, forcing 3 | a
--   - S_{5a} ⊆ {a, 5a/4, 5a/3}
--
-- Proof idea: The v48 left-degree theorem forces the incident heights to be
-- exactly {3a, 4a, 5a}. For each height, the candidate partners in the top
-- window are restricted by the constraint that partners must be > q/2.
-- Since a < 3q/5: 3a/4 < 9q/20 < q/2, 3a/5 < 9q/25 < q/2, so at 3a only 3a/2 works.
-- Similarly 4a/5 < 12q/25 < q/2, so at 4a only 4a/3 works.
-- At 5a, partners 5a/4 and 5a/3 are both > q/2 (need verification).
--
-- Simplified target: given the hypotheses, show that any b ≠ a with LCM(a,b) = 3a
-- and b ∈ (q/2, q] must satisfy 2*b = 3*a.

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-- Under the top window with a < 3q/5, if b ∈ (q/2, q] and LCM(a,b) = 3*a
    with b ≠ a, then 2*b = 3*a. -/
theorem deg3_partner_at_3a
    {q a b : ℕ}
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha_lb : q / 2 < a) (ha_ub : 5 * a < 3 * q)  -- a < 3q/5
    (hb_lb : q / 2 < b) (hb_ub : b ≤ q)
    (hne : a ≠ b)
    (hratio : 3 * a = 2 * b ∨ 3 * a = 4 * b ∨ 3 * a = 5 * b) :
    3 * a = 2 * b := by
  sorry
